special_abilities.name: amphibious
special_abilities.desc: The dragon can breathe air and water.

special_abilities.name: legendary resistance
special_abilities.desc: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The dragon can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) piercing damage.

actions.name: claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d6 + 8) slashing damage.

actions.name: tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d8 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: frightful presence
actions.desc: Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a DC 21 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: breath weapons
actions.desc:
The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.
Fire Breath. The dragon exhales fire in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw, taking 66 (12d10) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Weakening Breath. The dragon exhales gas in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 21 Strength saving throw or have disadvantage on Strength-based attack rolls, Strength checks, and Strength saving throws for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

legendary_actions.name: detect
legendary_actions.desc: The dragon makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary_actions.name: tail attack
legendary_actions.desc: The dragon makes a tail attack.

legendary_actions.name: wing attack (costs 2 actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 10 ft. of the dragon must succeed on a DC 22 Dexterity saving throw or take 15 (2d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

wikiData.lore:
The Adult Gold Dragon is the auric manifestation of solar justice. These venerable wyrms favor remote, mist-shrouded peaks or hidden geothermal grottos where the earth’s inner warmth mirrors their own radiant spirits. 

Unlike the feral hunger of their chromatic kin, the gold dragon’s predatory behavior is a study in patient vigilance. They rarely hunt for mere flesh; instead, they are stalkers of corruption. Often assuming the guise of humble wanderers or animals, they embed themselves within mortal societies to observe before unveiling their true, blinding majesty to incinerate the wicked. They consume the essence of chaos as much as physical sustenance.

In local folklore, they are revered as "The Sun’s Gilded Breath." To glimpse shimmering scales amidst the clouds is considered a divine omen, signaling a season of prosperity. Peasants tell tales of the "Silent Guardian," a golden-eyed stranger who arrives when a village is most imperiled, leaving behind only a trail of molten slag and the lingering scent of saffron and incense. They do not merely inhabit the landscape; they sanctify it, their very presence acting as a living bulwark against the encroaching dark.
